intent.goal: find stories related to international launch

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
u.database_name,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id 
LEFT JOIN generic_content gc ON u.page_id = gc.page_id
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass'
AND (
    u.database_name IN ('stories', 'journal', 'gmail')
    OR u.content_type IN ('stories', 'journal', 'gmail')
)
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%international%' 
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(gc.title) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(gc.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%launch%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000

sample_results.message_content: Dear Koii,   Thank you for raising your concerns regarding the financial impact this situation has on your side. We are committed to collaborating with you to find a fair and feasible solution.   The current situation is that the goods have already been unloaded and are now under customs clearance, which is estimated to be completed between October 5–8 . After that, the goods will need to be transported to a warehouse .   Action 1 – John is doing his utmost to secure an alternative warehouse in the UK at the most competitive rates possible .   Action 2 – We understand that access to the ShipBob UK facility is blocked until your VAT / EORI number is obtained. However, could you kindly clarify the reason why the UK facility is inaccessible when it is accepted for Canada and Australia?                     Based on our understanding and a check with ChatGPT, if there is no VAT number when importing to the UK, import VAT cannot be reclaimed until a valid VAT number is available.                     Once the VAT number is registered and valid, you will be able to submit the necessary documentation to reclaim the import VAT that was paid during customs clearance.                     What is the impact for ShipBob without EORI/VAT?   Could you also provide the expected timeline for obtaining your VAT/EORI number? How confident are you that you can secure both by October 24?   As mentioned in the email thread titled " BATCH 2025-07 SHIPMENT AND DOCUMENT ," following points are mentioned : the charges in the UK are higher. the "temporary storage arrangement" is intended only for the short term. Additionally, we have suggested considering holding the shipment at the factory until these two numbers are secured to avoid incurring further costs. But it hasn’t been considered. We had expected from this email thread that both numbers would be obtained by September .  In our previous email on July 31, we requested that if these numbers were received by September 13, there would be no need for temporary storage in the UK. Since there is no reply for this that we assumed these numbers are obtained in Sept. Therefore, we haven’t quoted for it. However, we do not expect to use the AU19/day rate as a reference, as it applies only to Australia.   As a valued partner, John is committed to assisting with the financial impact. Let's collaborate on the actions outlined above to reach a fair and feasible solution. We aim to provide an update on Action 1 by tomorrow. We appreciate your understanding and continued support.     Thanks with best regards Fionn Ng ******************************* MGM Industries & Co. Tel :   (852) 2545 0375 Fax :  (852) 2541 0362   From: Koii Benvenutto <koii@trassgames.com> Sent: Thursday, October 2, 2025 5:12 AM To: Fionn Ng <fionnng@mgmproduction.com.hk> Cc: jayshay <jayshay@trassgames.com>; John Chiu <johnchiu@mgmproduction.com.hk>; Steve Shockey <steve@trassgames.com> Subject: Re: BATCH 2025-07 UK SHIPMENT ETA SHIPBOB WAREHOUSE ON SEPT 5 2025   Dear Fionn, Thank you for your prompt reply. Let's work together and align on a solution. Our access to the ShipBob location is currently blocked due to the lagging UK tax registration process so storing the goods at the ShipBob location is not an option at this time. The £572/day storage rate is unworkable for us. This translates to over $23,000 USD over the next month—a cost we did not anticipate and cannot absorb. When we agreed to temporary storage, our only reference was the ~$19 AUD/day rate in Australia. We view this as a partnership, and we understand you have operational costs to cover. However, moving forward, we need transparency on the possibility of significant costs like this one, especially when they are this far outside the benchmark. Let's solve this together. As a starting point: Is there a fair one-time rate you can offer us that covers your essential costs while we arrange to move the goods ASAP? We trust your expertise. Please recommend a more suitable, cost-effective storage facility to which we can transfer the inventory. This is a learning opportunity for our team especially on international logistics. We will ensure our planning is tighter in the future. I can give you my word on that. And we ask for more proactive communication on any potential high-cost scenarios from your side. I look forward to your prompt reply. Best, Koii   Koii Benvenutto PM Plush and Merch koii@trassgames.com
